payload.text: **LESSONS candidate (s), 2026-09-17, vc's call at a fold:** vc wrote tests/unit/release.bats with the Write tool over an EXISTING file of 27 tests (devbin's notes generator) -- the tool's 'updated' reply was the only sign, and it was caught only by git diff --stat at the wrap. Check a path is free before creating a file under a name the tree may already use. And (t): a mutation harness under zsh passed '-f AC-1.2' as ONE word, so a filtered bats run executed nothing and a mutation 'survived' -- a harness result of zero red needs its test count too.
